issue: split-identity final — the touched-set sweep after #1649
note: This file IS the scope. relocate-pool-rows-by-list.cjs touches exactly these ids and nothing else. Every entry was read live by BOTH identity fields on 2026-09-02 and classified on its own stored evidence.
rulings: The touched-set split census is 399 documents, not 21. 327 of them are NOT damage: their cardId is a CardHedge/Cardsight vendor product id (e.g. 1778541805492x752149343116845600) and their hobbyiqCardId is the hiq slug. That is the DESIGNED cardhedge ingest shape, proved by a control read on unrelated cards outside the touched set: 1242 of 1242 cardhedge rows on hiq:basketball:2003:topps-chrome:111:base:no-auto and hiq:baseball:2023:bowman-draft:bdc-1:base:no-auto are vendor-id-partitioned the same way. Relocating them would be a mass mis-repair of the entire CardHedge pool, so this lane leaves every one of them alone.
Real damage is the 72 hiq-vs-hiq splits, where BOTH identity fields are hiq slugs that name different cards. Those are the only rows this list touches.
CPA-JG belongs to bowman, not bowman-chrome: all 117 2026 CPA-JG catalog rows carry setKey=bowman across every checklist source; zero carry bowman-chrome. Re-confirmed live 2026-09-02.

hiq:baseball:2026:bowman:cpa-jg:refractor:auto (no print run) is NOT a real card — zero card_catalog rows carry it, and the only unnumbered CPA-JG refractor in the checklist is /89. The 7 rows sitting in that phantom partition are base autos and are MOVED onto the checklist-backed base-auto row, not left to price a card that does not exist.

The genuine /499 Refractor is real and its canonical address is the bowman slug: card_catalog carries hiq:baseball:2026:bowman:cpa-jg:refractor:auto:num-499 (hobbymonitor-scraped-2026-08-31, parallel=Refractor, printRun=499). The bowman-chrome /499 slug is the same card at a stale address. Genuine /499 refractors mis-pointed there are REPOINTED to their own correct slug rather than flattened into the base pool — the earlier characterization of this partition as holding ONE genuine KEEP was wrong; it holds six.

A colour word only names a parallel when it is bound to a finish noun. 'Red Sox' is a team and '1st Bowman Chrome' is the product name — an earlier draft of the base-auto predicate rejected 30 legitimate base autos on those tokens alone. The predicate is quoted in each entry's evidence and every row failing it got individual treatment.

Duplicate pairs are deliberately OUT. 7 ids resolve to two documents at the same price and soldAt across different partitions; this lane patches or moves ONE document per id, and collapsing a pair is the dedup lane's job. Doing it here would silently lose a sale.

tca-ebay::127887746009 is Jeremy CIRIACO, not Jac Caglianone — CPA-JC is a colliding card number across two 2024 products. Per CF-BECKETT-INITIALS-COLLIDE a cardNumber alone is not identity, so it is excluded rather than swept into a Caglianone pool.

The two 2024 Caglianone ebay-user-purchase rows are excluded to the census: bowman-draft and bowman-chrome BOTH exist as catalog rows for CPA-JC /499 from different sources, so which one addresses 2024 Bowman Draft Chrome is an unresolved vocabulary decision, not a row repair — and these are user purchase rows, where a wrong move corrupts a cost basis.
